column1: # nxnative Mac keyboard map: one row per control, edited to rebind the keys.
# Columns: control  keycode  modifier   (tab-separated; the modifier is optional and only the right stick takes one)
#   control:  A B X Y LS RS L R ZL ZR Plus Minus Left Up Right Down (the buttons, in the Switch bit order)
#             LLeft LUp LDown LRight (the left stick)   RLeft RUp RRight RDown (the right stick)   Shake
#   keycode:  the macOS virtual key code (0..255, decimal or 0x hex), e.g. 38 is J, 13 is W, 36 is Return, 49 is Space.
#   modifier: shift / option / control / command, or empty (the right stick only; the default shares the arrow keys, with Shift for the right stick).
# See docs/mac-keyboard.md for the default and a key code reference. A change here rebuilds the host on the next Mac app build.
